title: A Whale Once Fooled a Diver Into Hearing a Human Voice
subject: beluga whale

scenes.text: A diver once surfaced and asked, who told me to get out?
Nobody had said a word. The voice came from a beluga whale named NOC.
Researchers recorded him in 1984. The sounds had a pitch of 200 to 300 hertz, right in the range of human speech.
The bursts lasted about three seconds, and he had lived beside people since 1977.
He did it on his own, and kept at it for about four years.
Then he stopped. A whale tried to talk to us, and we didn't understand.

description:
A diver surfaced and asked who told him to get out. It was a beluga named NOC.
In 1984 his handlers heard speech-like sounds at 200 to 300 hertz, and a study later described it in Current Biology.
What do you think he was trying to say? Comment below.
